# Calculate Reversibility Index

```{r}
#| label: reversibility-predator-id

compute_reversibility_id <- function(draws_df) {

  draws_df %>%
    group_by(.draw, ID_of_predators) %>%
    summarise(

      # Change during warming
      warming_change =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Warming" & Day == 14]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Warming" & Day == 7]),

      # Change during cooling
      cooling_change =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Recovery" & Day == 28]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Recovery" & Day == 21]),

      # Stable-treatment change during warming
      stable_warming =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 14]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 7]),

      # Stable-treatment change during cooling
      stable_cooling =
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 28]) -
        mean(.epred[Temperature == "Stable" & Day == 21]),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      warming_corrected =
        warming_change - stable_warming,

      cooling_corrected =
        cooling_change - stable_cooling,

      reversibility =
        cooling_corrected - warming_corrected
    )
}
```

# Top-Down Model (Figure 4)
##Create Prediction Grid

```{r}
newdata_id <- expand.grid(
  Temperature = c(
    "Stable",
    "Warming",
    "Recovery"
  ),
  Day = c(7, 14, 21, 28),
  Jar = NA,
  ID_of_predators = c(
    "None",
    "Blepharisma",
    "Euplotes",
    "Both"
  )
)
```

###Bacterial Abundance

```{r}
draws_abundance_id <- fit_bact_id %>%
  epred_draws(
    newdata = newdata_id,
    re_formula = NA
  )

contrast_abundance_id <- compute_reversibility_id(
  draws_abundance_id
) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Abundance")

```

###Bacterial Diversity
```{r}
draws_shannon_id <- fit_shannon_id %>%
  epred_draws(
    newdata = newdata_id,
    re_formula = NA
  )

contrast_shannon_id <- compute_reversibility_id(
  draws_shannon_id
) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Shannon")
```

### Bacterial Composition
```{r}
draws_beta_id <- fit_beta_id %>%
```

### Algal Abundance
```{r}
draws_algae_id <- fit_algae_id %>%

```

### Combine posterior reversibility distributions + Standardize

```{r}
reversibility_id_df <- bind_rows(
  contrast_abundance_id,
  contrast_shannon_id,
  contrast_beta_id,
  contrast_algae_id
)

# Standardize reversibility within each response variable for visualization
reversibility_id_df <- reversibility_id_df %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(
    reversibility_std =
      reversibility / sd(reversibility, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```


##Spider Plot 


```{r}
#| label: figure-colors


# Recovery scenario colors
recovery_cols <- c(
  "Compounding"      = "#0B4A8B",
  "No recovery"      = "#5E90E8",
  "Partial recovery" = "#1AB5A8",
  "Perfect recovery" = "#D8C93C",
  "Overcompensation" = "#9ACD00"
)

# Predator identity colors
pred_colors <- c(
  "None"        = "#4D4D4D",
  "Blepharisma" = "#D10F8C",
  "Euplotes"    = "#E85D04",
  "Both"        = "#6A51A3"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: spider-setup

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Spider plot axes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

axis_min <- -2
axis_max <-  2

text_col <- "black"
grid_col <- "#EAF2FA"

metric_order <- c(
  "Abundance",
  "Shannon",
  "Beta",
  "Algae"
)

axis_df <- data.frame(
  metric = factor(
    metric_order,
    levels = metric_order
  ),

  metric_label = c(
    "Bacterial\nabundance",
    "Bacterial\ndiversity",
    "Bacterial\ncomposition",
    "Algal\nabundance"
  ),

  angle = c(
    pi / 2,
    pi,
    0,
    3 * pi / 2
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize posterior reversibility distributions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

radar_df <- reversibility_id_df %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = metric_order
    ),

    ID_of_predators = factor(
      ID_of_predators,
      levels = c(
        "None",
        "Blepharisma",
        "Euplotes",
        "Both"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    ID_of_predators,
    metric
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    RI_median = median(
      reversibility_std,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    RI_low = quantile(
      reversibility_std,
      0.05,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    RI_high = quantile(
      reversibility_std,
      0.95,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert standardized reversibility to radial coordinates
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

radar_df <- radar_df %>%
  left_join(
    axis_df,
    by = "metric"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    ID_of_predators,
    angle
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    r_plot =
      (RI_median - axis_min) /
      (axis_max - axis_min),

    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  )


# Close each predator-identity polygon
radar_closed <- radar_df %>%
  group_by(ID_of_predators) %>%
  arrange(
    angle,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    slice(., 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| label: spider-grid

grid_levels <- seq(
  0.2,
  1,
  by = 0.2
)



# Spider grid
grid_closed <- expand.grid(
  r_plot = grid_levels,
  angle = axis_df$angle
) %>%
  mutate(
    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    r_plot,
    angle
  ) %>%
  group_by(r_plot) %>%
  bind_rows(
    slice(., 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Radial axis lines
axis_lines <- axis_df %>%
  crossing(
    r_plot = c(0, 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  )


# RI = 0 reference polygon
zero_grid <- expand.grid(
  r_plot =
    (0 - axis_min) /
    (axis_max - axis_min),

  angle = axis_df$angle
) %>%
  mutate(
    x = r_plot * cos(angle),
    y = r_plot * sin(angle)
  ) %>%
  arrange(angle) %>%
  bind_rows(
    slice(., 1)
  )

```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

axis_min <- -2
axis_max <- 2

# Spider plot colors
text_col <- "black"
grid_col <- "#EAF2FA"


spider_fig4 <- ggplot() +

  # Grid
  geom_path(
    data = grid_closed,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      group = r_plot
    ),
    color = grid_col,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +

  # Axis lines
  geom_line(
    data = axis_lines,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      group = metric
    ),
    color = grid_col,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +

  # RI = 0
  geom_path(
    data = zero_grid,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "11"
  ) +

  # RI = 0 label
  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(
      x = 0.42,
      y = -0.18,
      label = "RI = 0"
    ),
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      label = label
    ),
    color = "black",
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    angle = 45
  ) +

  # Predator identity polygons
  geom_path(
    data = radar_closed,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      color = ID_of_predators,
      group = ID_of_predators
    ),
    linewidth = 2,
    linejoin = "round"
  ) +

  # Axis labels
  geom_text(
    data = axis_df,
    aes(
      x = 1.23 * cos(angle),
      y = 1.23 * sin(angle),
      label = metric_label
    ),
    size = 10,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = text_col,
    lineheight = 0.85
  ) +

  # Predator colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = pred_colors
  ) +

  coord_equal(
    xlim = c(-1.45, 1.45),
    ylim = c(-1.45, 1.45),
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_void(
    base_size = 18
  ) +

  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      color = NA
    ),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      color = NA
    ),

    legend.position = "none",

    plot.margin = margin(
      40,
      40,
      40,
      40
    )
  )


spider_fig4
```
## Posterior Probability Distributions 

```{r}
#| label: recovery-scenarios-predator-id

# ---- Panel B: cooling scenario probabilities ----

metric_levels <- c(
  "Bacterial abundance",
  "Shannon diversity",
  "Beta diversity",
  "Algal abundance"
)


# Combine posterior draws across response variables
plot_cat_df <- bind_rows(
  contrast_abundance_id,
  contrast_shannon_id,
  contrast_beta_id,
  contrast_algae_id
)

# 5% tolerance for recovery classification
tol <- 0.05

plot_cat_df <- plot_cat_df %>%
  mutate(
    RI_category = case_when(

      # No recovery
      abs(cooling_corrected) <
        tol * abs(warming_corrected) ~
        "No recovery",

      # Perfect recovery
      abs(warming_corrected + cooling_corrected) <
        tol * abs(warming_corrected) ~
        "Perfect recovery",

      # Overcompensation
      (warming_corrected - cooling_corrected) < 0 ~
        "Overcompensation",

      # Partial recovery
      sign(cooling_corrected) != sign(warming_corrected) &
        abs(cooling_corrected) < abs(warming_corrected) ~
        "Partial recovery",
      # Compounding
      TRUE ~
        "Compounding"
    )
  )


ri_levels <- c(
  "Compounding",
  "No recovery",
  "Partial recovery",
  "Complete reversibility",
  "Overcompensation"
)

ri_colors_cb <- c(
  "Compounding"            = "#0B4A8B",
  "No recovery"            = "#5E90E8",
  "Partial recovery"       = "#1AB5A8",
  "Complete reversibility" = "#D8C93C",
  "Overcompensation"       = "#9ACD00"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: recovery-probabilities-predator-id

prob_df <- plot_cat_df %>%
  count(
    metric,
    ID_of_predators,
    RI_category
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    metric,
    ID_of_predators
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prob = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(

    ID_of_predators = factor(
      ID_of_predators,
      levels = c(
        "None",
        "Euplotes",
        "Blepharisma",
        "Both"
      )
    ),

    RI_category = factor(
      RI_category,
      levels = c(
        "Overcompensation",
        "Perfect recovery",
        "Partial recovery",
        "No recovery",
        "Compounding"
      )
    ),

    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c(
        "Abundance",
        "Shannon",
        "Beta",
        "Algae"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(metric)
  )

# ----------------------------
# Plot Formatting
# ----------------------------

bar_width <- 0.7

boundary_df <- prob_df %>%
  filter(
    RI_category == "Overcompensation"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    metric,
    ID_of_predators
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    y_boundary = sum(prob),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x_num = as.numeric(metric),
    x_start = x_num - bar_width / 2,
    x_end = x_num + bar_width / 2
  )

scale_x_discrete(
  labels = c(
    "Bacterial abundance" = "Bacterial\nAbundance",
    "Shannon diversity"   = "Bacterial\nDiversity",
    "Beta diversity"      = "Bacterial\nComposition",
    "Algal abundance"     = "Algal\nAbundance"
  )
)

```

```{r}
#| label: panel-b-figure4
#| fig-width: 13.5
#| fig-height: 8

panel_B_fig4 <- ggplot(
  prob_df,
  aes(
    x = metric,
    y = prob,
    fill = RI_category
  )
) +

  geom_col(
    width = 0.9,
    color = NA,
    linewidth = 0,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ID_of_predators,
    nrow = 2,
    as.table = TRUE,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = recovery_cols
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.02)
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "Abundance" = "Bac.\nAbundance",
      "Shannon"   = "Bac.\nDiversity",
      "Beta"      = "Bac.\nComposition",
      "Algae"     = "Algal\nAbundance"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Probability",
    fill = "Recovery Scenario"
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = boundary_df,
    aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_end,
      y = y_boundary,
      yend = y_boundary
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#D8C93C",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),

    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.position = "none",

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 27
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 25,
      face = "bold",
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 25
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 24,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(
      0.5,
      "lines"
    ),

    panel.spacing.y = unit(
      0.75,
      "lines"
    ),

    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      color = NA
    ),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "transparent",
      color = NA
    )
  )
```
